lessons: Parse object names at the final underscore; category names may contain underscores.
Assign distinct baskets to distinct categories and preserve unambiguous existing category placements.
Normalize supplied downward quaternions and use the supplied contact offset, minimum tool height, and basket release height.
Visible instance keys are not persistent tracking identities; refresh perception and associate by category and nearby position.
Gripper and motion returns do not establish grasp or placement success. Do not retry uncertain manipulation.
development_feedback: All supplied runs reached the 1100-action limit without success; some showed partial scores. No primitive-level failure trace was supplied, so no particular grasp, trajectory, or placement failure can be identified.
repair_strategy: Use a finite target list, exclude objects already inside baskets, avoid repeated manipulation attempts, and terminate when transfer state becomes uncertain.
